title: Dianchi Water: Dataset & Benchmark Code for Time-Series Imputation under Structured Missingness
description: Code release accompanying the Dianchi Water benchmark: the executable eight-stage data-curation pipeline (station identity canonicalization, sentinel remapping, duplicate reconciliation), natural-missingness workload generation, the mask-view augmentation strategy (MAS) training protocol, and imputation/forecasting benchmark harnesses for 11 architectures on a curated surface-water-quality panel from the Dianchi Lake basin automatic monitoring network (22 stations, 9 variables, four-hourly sampling, 2022-2024, 19.8% natural missingness), with cross-dataset replication on Beijing Air Quality and ETTh1. The dataset itself is released separately on Hugging Face under CC BY 4.0.
notes: Fengming Zhang and Ke Yu contributed equally.
